# appgatesdp_recorded_sessions (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `descending` (String) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `order_by` (String) The field name to sort the result list. Supported fields vary from object to object. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `query` (String) Query string to filter the result list. It's used for various fields depending on the object type. Send multiple query parameters to make the queries more specific.
- `range` (String) 'Range string to limit the result list. Format: -. 3-10 means the items between the (including) 3rd and the 10th
 will be returned. Defaults to all objects.'
- `site_name` (String) Filter results to Gateways in the Site with this name.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `disk_usage` (Attributes) Aggregate recording-volume capacity (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disk_usage))
- `filter_by` (Attributes List) The filters applied to the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_by))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `queries` (List of String) The queries applied to the list.
- `total_count` (Number) The total readable count of entities. Not influenced by the query.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) The device ID, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of a user&device combination. Format: "CN=,CN=,OU="
- `download_format` (String) The preferred download format for the primary artifact.
- `entitlement_name` (String) The name of the Entitlement that authorized the session.
- `export_bytes` (Number) On-disk size of the MP4 export, in bytes. Null when no export exists.
- `export_hash` (String) The sha256 hash of the converted MP4, present once exportStatus is complete.
- `export_progress` (Number) Live convert percent (0-100) while exportStatus is "converting"; null otherwise.
- `export_status` (String) The MP4 export lifecycle state. Poll this after requesting a conversion.
- `failure_reason` (String) Why a terminated or failed capture ended; null for a clean recording.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the Gateway that owns this recording. Use this when converting or downloading.
- `has_export` (Boolean) Whether an MP4 export is already available.
- `host` (String) The host the session was connected to.
- `id` (String) The recording session id (Gateway session token).
- `integrity_hash` (String) The tamper-evidence hash of the raw .guac recording.
- `provider_name` (String) The provider name of the user, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `recording_bytes` (Number) On-disk size of the raw .guac recording, in bytes. Null when the file is absent.
- `session_end` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the session ended.
- `session_start` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the session started.
- `site` (String) The ID of the Site the Gateway is assigned to.
- `site_name` (String) The name of the Site the Gateway is assigned to.
- `source_ip` (String) The client tunnel IP the session originated from.
- `status` (String) The recording status.
- `type` (String) The protocol of the recorded session.
- `username` (String) The username, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.


<a id="nestedatt--disk_usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk_usage`

Read-Only:

- `free_bytes` (Number) Free capacity across the recording volumes, in bytes.
- `total_bytes` (Number) Total capacity of the recording volumes, in bytes.


<a id="nestedatt--filter_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter_by`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The field name the filter is applied to.
- `value` (String) The value used for comparison.
